scope: DY and gluon-fusion Higgs first accepted QCD-emission CDF; no new showers run by this settings audit
provenance_limit: Contemporaneous source and XML/tune defaults; no archived producing-run log or binary hash certifies that this exact configuration produced the tables.

particle_masses.explanation: The wrapper loads metadata masses, then overrides particle IDs 1-4 to zero. Preserve the original metadata in the Fortran interpolation call.

effective_ISR_particle_mass_thresholds_G.source: SpaceShower.cc and SimpleSpaceShower.cc: MCMIN=1.2, MBMIN=4.0; mc=max(MCMIN,m0(4)), mb=max(MBMIN,m0(5)).

alphaStrong_internal_thresholds_GeV.explanation: Both old and new AlphaStrong::init default to these values. Distinct from the shower particle thresholds.

intentionally_distinct.reason: Measure physical backward evolution against forward PDF-free tables multiplied by event PDF ratios.
The table API directly calls prepare(iSys,state,true) and evolves from explicit pTbegAll. Replay sets SCALUP to the same chosen Q, requiring explicit limiting.

intentionally_distinct.historical: ISR literal defaults on; FSR quark/lepton/other off; gamma default on
intentionally_distinct.reason: Both historical custom pTnext overloads call only pT2nextQCD, irrespective of QED dipoles prepared.
PDF-free mode 1/2 ISR tables do not encode a beam PDF; shower and Delta use the same provider for each control.
Explicitly allowed by user; code and kinematic differences remain.

intentionally_distinct.historical: Auxiliary s=(7000 GeV)^2, x=.1, dummy massless radiator/recoiler
intentionally_distinct.rerun: Physical 13 TeV Born states, event x, common starting Q
intentionally_distinct.reason: Forward tables are reused as functions of dipole mass and cuts; no claim of identical auxiliary trial kinematics.
Preserve existing Born replay and scales. All incoming production scales and SCALUP equal the chosen Q; source API uses explicit Q.

API_observation.ISR: SpaceShower::noEmissionProbability sets doTrialNow=true and prepares dummy ends. Its custom pTnext evolves only side A and calls pT2nextQCD; it does not construct branch kinematics.
API_observation.FSR: The TimeShower custom pTnext overload calls only pT2nextQCD.
API_observation.reference: A full-event shower hook records the first accepted QCD emission, including branch construction. Exact equality to the auxiliary table is not guaranteed.

first_emission_relevance.pT0: Must force zero via Settings::forceParm; readString zero violates the XML minimum. Both the coupling argument and regularizing denominator change.
first_emission_relevance.pTdampMatch3: Inactive: replay pTmaxMatch=1 sets dopTlimit1=true; singlets also have no heavy coloured final legs.
first_emission_relevance.FSR_recoil_and_gToQQ: Reset to historical defaults for consistency; cannot affect the first QCD emission because Born final legs are colourless.
first_emission_relevance.azimuth: Reset all Space/Time flags off. Gluon-polarization findAsymPol also returns when there is no coloured Born final leg.

nominal_variations: UncertaintyBands:doVariations remains off. The full reference showers do not use merging trial machinery, so the unchanged Merging variation defaults do not activate shower variations.
technical_settings: Historical Check:epTolErr=.01 and abortIfVeto=on are technical controls, not kernel parameters; the reference retains its original event checks. Beams:setProductionScalesFromLHEF=on is retained as explicitly documented above.

settings_without_historical_counterpart.SpaceShower:dipoleRecoil: off (global ISR recoil, corresponding to the old implementation)
settings_without_historical_counterpart.TimeShower additions: Only FSR settings; cannot affect first QCD emission for these colourless Born final states.

internal_ISR_cutoff.method: Independent arithmetic using the common historical/current AlphaStrong one-loop formulas, MZ=91.188, alphaS(MZ)=.130, thresholds mb=4.8,mc=1.5. Both SpaceShower versions have LAMBDA3MARGIN=1.1. At pT0=0, pTmin=max(configured,1.1*Lambda3).
internal_ISR_cutoff.interpretation: This common automatic infrared floor is not a mismatch. It is below every analysis cutoff.

changes_reviewed: All 85 shared settings checked against independent audit after initialization
Explicit configured versus effective ISR cutoff labeling
Source equality required when reusing completed trials
Known PDF15 heavy-threshold errors retained, counted and qualified; primary PDF13 must remain free of Error/Abort diagnostics
final_runner_review.diagnostic_source_check: SimpleSpaceShower.cc has CTHRESHOLD=BTHRESHOLD=2 and calls pT2nearThreshold only when pT2 < m2Threshold <= 2*mQ^2. The xPDF=0 diagnostic returns from that routine. The corresponding upper scales are sqrt(2)*1.2=1.6971 GeV and sqrt(2)*4.8=6.7883 GeV. Preserve qualification of lower-cutoff results; these errors do not establish a defect in higher-scale evolution.
